title: Irish German Crumble
description: A unique twist on traditional German desserts, incorporating Irish and citrusy flavors.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine bulgur, wheat, sugar, and crumble.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and Irish cream liqueur (if using).
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing until a smooth batter forms.
Transfer the batter to a greased 9-inch (23cm) springform pan.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Dust with additional crumble and serve warm.
Optional: garnish with orange zest and juice.
